_comment: HBM3 6400 MT/s all-0s IDD rails (per pseudo-channel, ECC, off-power excluded) + data-pattern read/write energy model. Reuses the HBM2 sec.16 shape coefficients but DROPS cross-coupling (use_coupling=false) and uses the relative/K-free form: the config IDD4R/IDD4W (all-0s, the reference activity) is scaled by pj(knobs)/pj(reference). dq_rate/tsv_rate/bg_rate are the per-bus activity knobs in [0,1].
